title: Baire-type properties of topological vector spaces
summary: Burzyk, Kliś and Lipecki proved that every topological vector space (tvs) $E$ with the property $(K)$ is a Baire space. Kcakol and Sánchez Ruiz proved that every sequentially complete Fréchet--Urysohn locally convex space (lcs) is Baire. Being motivated by the property $(K)$ and the notion of a Mackey null sequence we introduce a property $(MK)$ which is strictly weaker than the property $(K)$, and show that any locally complete lcs has the property $(MK)$.
